trigger: Objective mixes outcome, implementation and validation in one sentence
problem: Build a router, improve reasoning, add persistence and prove it works without separating deliverables
wrong_pattern: Treat the entire objective as one task and declare progress after writing code
cause: Goal has multiple independently verifiable outcomes
correct_method: attach acceptance criteria to each goal
do not mark parent complete until all child goals pass
verification: Every child goal has one measurable output and parent completion is derived from child PASS states

trigger: Repeated rework despite many completed tasks
problem: The agent repeatedly edits finished areas because goals are not decomposed into stable contracts
cause: No mapping from parent goal to atomic acceptance criteria
correct_method: replan only failed or impacted children
verification: A change to one child goal invalidates only its downstream dependents

trigger: Task starts before required schema exists
problem: Router integration begins while registry schema is still undefined
verification: Router node remains BLOCKED until schema and registry nodes are PASS

problem: A depends on B and B depends on A
cause: Cycle in graph invalidates executable DAG
correct_method: identify mistaken dependency or merge atomic unit

trigger: HTTP 200 but workflow never emits state=final
problem: One observation suggests success while terminal-state evidence shows failure
wrong_pattern: HTTP 200 means the whole workflow works
cause: Transport success was conflated with functional completion
verification: State is represented as transport=PASS and completion=FAIL, not global PASS

trigger: Two log lines differ but refer to different requests
problem: Naive contradiction detector flags status=PASS and status=FAIL without correlating trace IDs
correct_method: compare only claims sharing subject and time window
retain both observations if scopes differ
verification: No conflict is emitted when evidence subjects differ

trigger: Patch looks correct but may break concurrent workers
problem: Decision is made from single happy-path reasoning
cause: No adversarial, failure or concurrency scenario
verification: Candidate is rejected if a critical scenario violates an invariant

trigger: Two fixes have similar expected success
problem: Fix A is faster but has larger irreversible blast radius than Fix B
cause: Expected value ignores tail risk and reversibility
correct_method: prefer robust reversible option when expected utility is close
verification: Decision record includes expected, worst-case and rollback scores

trigger: New architecture document changes one interface
problem: Agent proposes rebuilding the full project
wrong_pattern: Reset all tasks after any input change
verification: Unrelated PASS nodes preserve state and hashes

trigger: Security constitution changes global execution permissions
problem: Minimal branch replan would miss a global policy change
wrong_pattern: Always invalidate only direct document consumers
cause: Some sources have global authority scope
correct_method: if global constitution changed mark all policy-dependent execution nodes STALE
preserve purely documentary nodes if unaffected
verification: All nodes using changed policy are revalidated

problem: Majority vote favors an answer contradicted by runtime evidence
cause: Votes are not weighted by objective evidence or correlated-error risk
verification: Candidate with failing objective test cannot win solely by votes

problem: One cheap test would distinguish both before any patch
cause: Decision policy ignores expected information gain
correct_method: estimate discriminating value of available tests
verification: Chosen first action reduces uncertainty more than direct patching
